items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe over an algebraic space becomes a quotient stack after a flat finitely presented base change of the base (author lemma at source lines 6247-6259, label lemma-local-structure-gerbe). The proof (source lines 6261-6284) uses the surjectivity flatness and finite presentation of the gerbe morphism to find a cover over which a section exists and applies the section result (proof lines 6261-6283). The construction of the cover with a section is the substance. H3.
